name: Newton-Raphson for Refraction Point Search
aliases: 1D Newton-Raphson search for triangle without shading normals
definition: An iterative method to find the x-coordinate of the refraction point P on a triangle edge (lying in the y=0 plane) given a viewer V on the y-axis and a light source L, by solving for the zero of a function f(x) derived from Snell's law.
summary: This 1D Newton-Raphson method finds refraction points on triangle edges with constant normals, distinguished by an empirical heuristic for the initial guess and clamping to ensure the solution remains on the edge.
